messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] spike in 5xx on /v1/prompt-mux-edge (prod) · 10:03 UTC · Severity: P2
incident-bot: link: https://monitoring.redwood/c/alerts/78901 · current 5xx 22% (baseline 0.3%) · correlated with rollout id rollout-2026-03-15-1000

Maya: on call, looking now. paging @sam @eli

deploy-bot: rollout-2026-03-15-1000 finished · commit b7e4f21 · enabled feature_flag prompt_mux_v2 => 100% in prod

Eli: seeing backend timeouts to mux-agent pools, connection handshake failures to variant q4lite -> 502s and timeouts. router queue depth climbing.
Eli: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-15T10:02:58Z prompt-router-2a3 WARN handshake_err: protocol mismatch from 10.5.8.21:9000
2026-03-15T10:03:01Z prompt-router-2a3 ERROR dispatch: backend_timeout -> 504
```

Sam: can we kill the feature flag? I want traffic off the mux path until we confirm compatibility.
Sam: running ffctl now:
```
ffctl update prompt_mux_v2 --env prod --set false --actor sam
```

Maya: go ahead. tagging release to hold.

deploy-bot: feature update accepted · change_id ff-roll-9902 · propagating to regions (us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-central-1)

event-bus: [info] ff-roll-9902 partial propagation complete (us-east-1), remaining regions pending

Eli: us-east sees errors drop already. overall 5xx down to 6% and dropping. KV cache pressure normalizing.

Cassie: CS reporting multiple customers hit between 10:01-10:04. Affected: NovaData (critical), Ledgerly (medium), Queryable (low). NovaData flagged as SEV high; opening escalations.

Maya: summary: new routing (prompt_mux_v2) sent some traffic to q4lite variant that uses incompatible protocol frames. kill-switch applied. we'll hold the queued release. handoff to Sam to monitor for 30m and coordinate rollback/patch with release.

Sam: taking watch. I'll file rollback/block ticket and ask release to freeze any further rollouts until RCA. Ticket REL-9420 created.

Eli: saving traces for postmortem — sample trace:
```
trace: a9c7b2 · route /v1/prompt-mux-edge -> backend q4lite
response: 502 Bad Gateway
backend_err: handshake_error: expected v2 header, received v0
```

Cassie: notified NovaData account team. CS tickets: CS-8920, CS-8921, CS-8922. Requesting request-ids and sample logs from SRE to attach.

Maya: ff-roll-9902 reached full propagation · prompt_mux_v2=false in all regions · deploy-bot

event-bus: overall 5xx returned to baseline at 10:09 UTC · alert auto-closed

Sam: I'll remain primary oncall for next 30 mins. plan: 1) monitor metrics 2) coordinate with releases on REL-9420 3) schedule quick sync with ENG-ML to add a compatibility gate.

Eli: I'll lead the RCA and implement an automated protocol compatibility check in the model onboarding pipeline. provisional owners: Eli (RCA & fix), Sam (release gating + infra safeguards), Maya (incident lead & customer comms), Cassie (CS follow-ups).

Maya: handoff note to Sam: "Monitor until 10:40 UTC, confirm sustained <1% 5xx and block release-2026-03-15-1100."

Sam: ack. releasing a brief incident summary to stakeholders and asking product to add gating in rollout checklist.

incident-bot: RESOLVED: spike in 5xx on /v1/prompt-mux-edge · duration 6m 12s · responders: Maya, Sam, Eli, Cassie

--
Quick actions to track:
- REL-9420: block / roll back queued release & remove prompt_mux_v2 from artifact (Sam)
- ENG-ML-118: add protocol compatibility test during onboarding (Eli)
- PM-489: require canary gating for prompt routing feature flags (Product)
- CS-8945: confirm impacted customers received remediation notes and closure (Cassie)
